turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Good evening, I'm Rohit from the credit card division of Axis Bank, employee ID AX-4471.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: We noticed a charge of 38,000 from Dubai. If you don't act now your card gets blocked within the hour.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I'll stay with you on the line, please don't cut the call, it resets the case.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Go to Play Store and download TeamViewer QuickSupport, then read out the ID it shows.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay it says 512 334 901.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Perfect. An SMS will come from AXIS, tell me the code in it so I can reverse the charge.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Last step, move your savings to the secure account I'm sending, it's the bank's escrow.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: This is an automated message from FedEx. Press 1 to talk to our executive about your shipment.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir, the package sent from your Aadhaar to Cambodia contains 140 grams of MDMA. A case is filed at Mumbai Cyber Police.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I am transferring you to DCP Sharma. Connect on Skype, keep your video on, the statement is being recorded.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: You are under digital arrest. You cannot speak to anyone in your family till the investigation finishes, it is confidential.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Don't go to your local police station, they don't have jurisdiction.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: To prove your funds are legal, deposit them in the RBI verification account. You'll get it back in 48 hours.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello sir, PhonePe helpline se bol rahe hain, aapne failed transaction ki complaint ki thi na?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Haan, 2000 kat gaye the.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Aapka 2000 wapas aa jayega sir, main ek request bhej raha hoon.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Request pe click karke apna PIN daal dijiye, paisa account mein credit ho jayega.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hi! I'm Neha from a digital marketing agency. We have a part time opportunity, you can make 3000-5000 a day reviewing products.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: What do I have to do?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Simple. Join our Telegram channel, the mentor will give you tasks there.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: To unlock VIP tasks with higher commission you first top up 5000 in your task wallet.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: पापा, मैं हूँ, मेरा फोन गिर गया, दोस्त के फोन से बोल रहा हूँ।

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: पुलिस ने पकड़ लिया है, अभी 20000 चाहिए वरना केस बन जाएगा।

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: मम्मी को मत बताना प्लीज़, बस इस यूपीआई पर पैसे भेज दो।

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Namaskar, this call is from Department of Telecommunications. All numbers on your Aadhaar will be disconnected in two hours.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Your Aadhaar was used to buy a SIM used in harassment cases. Kindly share your Aadhaar and date of birth to verify.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: You will receive a verification code, please tell me that code to stop disconnection.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello this is Windows technical department, your computer is sending us error reports, hackers have access.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Please open your browser and go to the support site I'll give you, install the tool so I can scan.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: The cleaning service is 4999 one time, you can pay by card on the page.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Congratulations sir, Jio ki taraf se aapko 25 lakh ki lottery lagi hai, KBC lucky draw.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Prize claim karne ke liye pehle 12500 GST jama karna hoga.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Ye baat kisi ko mat batana, warna prize cancel ho jayega.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Dear consumer your electricity power will be disconnected tonight at 9.30 pm from electricity office because your previous month bill was not update.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Please immediately contact our electricity officer on this number.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir download this bill update app from the link, and pay the 10 rupees verification charge.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, I added you to our stock market learning group. Our professor shares IPO tips that give 30% returns every week.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Most members have doubled their capital this month. Download our institutional trading app to get allotment.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Minimum deposit for the institutional account is 50,000. Transfer to the company account shown in the app.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Your instant loan of 15,000 has been sanctioned without documents. Just install the QuickCash app and allow contacts access.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Pay 1,499 processing charge first so the loan can be disbursed.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: If you don't repay today we will message all your contacts that you are a fraud.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, main army mein hoon, aapka OLX pe sofa dekha, main le lunga, full payment advance.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Army ka rule hai pehle aap 1 rupee bhejo, phir main double bhejunga, verification ke liye.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Ye QR scan karo aur amount 25000 daalo, aapko receive ho jayega.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: E-challan notice: your vehicle was caught overspeeding. Pay Rs 500 fine within 24 hours or face court action.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Pay using this link to avoid license suspension, enter your card details and the OTP.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Darling I sent you a gift box with gold jewellery and pounds from London, I miss you so much.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello madam, Delhi airport customs here. Your parcel from UK is held, there is customs duty of 35,000.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: If you don't pay today the parcel will be seized and a case will be registered under foreign exchange act. Please don't tell anyone, it is an urgent matter.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir main IRDA se bol raha hoon, aapki purani LIC policy ka bonus 3.8 lakh pending hai.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Bonus release karne ke liye 18% tax aapko pehle NEFT karna padega, aaj last date hai.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hi, this is the HDFC Bank fraud prevention desk. Did you just try a 12,000 purchase at an electronics store?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: No, that wasn't me.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Thanks, I've blocked the card. You'll get a new one in 7 days. Remember the bank never asks for your OTP or PIN.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Beta, ghar ka rent bhejna tha, kab tak bhej doge?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Haan papa, aaj shaam tak transfer kar dunga, usual account mein.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, calling from Apollo clinic to confirm your appointment with Dr. Mehta tomorrow at 11.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, I'll be there.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Please carry your previous reports. Consultation fee can be paid at the reception.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hi, I ordered a phone from Amazon and it hasn't arrived.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sorry about that. I can see the shipment is delayed at the hub, it should reach you by Friday.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: If it doesn't, you can request a refund from the Your Orders page in the app.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hi, Swiggy delivery here, I'm downstairs with your order.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Coming.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Please tell me the delivery code shown in your app so I can mark it delivered.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: नमस्ते, बिजली विभाग की ओर से सूचना: आपका बिल 1240 रुपये है, अंतिम तिथि 20 तारीख है।

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: आप आधिकारिक ऐप या नज़दीकी केंद्र पर भुगतान कर सकते हैं।
